section_summary.extract_value: This section details a Confirmatory Factor Analysis (CFA) performed on a 10-item one-factor model, examining its fit for a whole sample and various subsamples based on gender and weight status. The analysis tested for measurement invariance across gender and weight status, with modifications made to improve model fit for gender invariance. Table 2 presents the model fit indices for these analyses, including sample sizes for boys (n=438), girls (n=402), underweight & normoweight group (n=592), and overweight & obese group (n=248).
